```{r}
#| label: cover-image
#| include: true
#| echo: false
#| eval: false

# load the library
# library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
# library(tidyverse)

# Dataset 1: one value per group
data <- data.frame(
  name=c("north","south","south-east","north-west","south-west","north-east","west","east"),
  val=sample(seq(1,10), 8 )
)
#%>%
  # filter(name !='south'&
  #          name !='west'&
  #          name != "south-west"&
  #          name != "north-east")

data %>%
  arrange(val) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels=c("north", "north-east", "east", "south-east", "south", "south-west", "west", "north-west"))) %>% 
  ggplot( aes(x=name, y=val)) +
    geom_segment( aes(xend=name, yend=0, 
                      linewidth=10
                      )) +
    geom_point( size=90, 
                #color="#E8D6EB"
                color='#B9A135'
                ) +
    theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_blank(), 
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(
      #fill="#B9A135",
      fill='#E8D6Eb',
      #color = "#B9A135"
      color='#E8D6EB'
      )
    )+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add=c(2,3)))
  

ggsave("plot.png", width = 2400, height = 1350, units = "px", dpi = 72)
```
